### What's Changed in v0.84.7

- **Native Go Fiber Backend & Dedicated Storage Architecture**: Transitioned the municipal emergency response backend to a high-performance native Go (Fiber v2 + GORM) micro-daemon running directly on Linux VPS. Persistent media assets are now isolated in `/var/www/sine-storage` with structured subfolders and symlinked storage mapping.
- **Unified Port 3000 Services & Hardened Firewall**: Unified REST API endpoints, static media serving, tile caching, and real-time WebSockets onto port 3000. Configured UFW firewall rules on the production VPS for low-latency client communication.
- **Database Media Path Normalization**: Updated all database records across `user_profiles`, `user_verifications`, and `broadcasts` to accurately point to the isolated storage path on port 3000, eliminating legacy port references.
- **Automated Schema Migrations & System Seeders**: Fully integrated 16 GORM relational data models with automatic schema migrations on startup, paired with automated idempotent seeders for all 9 San Isidro barangays, incident types, responders, vehicles, and administration accounts.
- **Full-Screen Interactive Map Reveal**: Integrated the edge-to-edge full-screen interactive map reveal with smooth gesture handling, responsive bottom-sheet integration, and instant pinpoint centering.
- **Synchronized Global Dark Mode Transition**: Refactored theme transition styles across all components, containers, and dialogs to ensure perfectly unified 250ms cross-dissolve dark mode transitions without visual delay.
- **Interactive Tour Engine Calibration**: Enhanced spotlight tour overlay math to prevent highlight overshooting and ensure pixel-accurate element targeting across both desktop and mobile viewports.
- **Transactional Communication & Safety Backups**: Integrated Resend API mailer with CLI testing capabilities, PhilSMS transactional SMS gateway, and automated 2-hour compressed Gzip database snapshots. Legacy backend environment archived for instant fallback.
